label: Abstract-only rival of concrete population survives, checked (inference)
rule: Explicit one-world interpretation, checked by case analysis
meaning: Rival test for the concrete-population premise against its smallest consumer, NecessaryRootFork.necessaryRootTrilemma (premises: concrete population, excluded middle). In an interpretation with one existing non-concrete candidate the abstract-only rival and excluded middle hold and the trilemma fails. This is a model-witnessed survival of the rival, not a refutation or defence of the premise; the interpretation is not claimed metaphysically possible. Excluded middle is supplied by Lean's classical axioms.
